items.evidence: 'if (globalIndex < n) { value = input[globalIndex]; }', 'extern __shared__ float sharedData[]' with launch size threadsPerBlock*sizeof(float), __syncthreads after init and within loop, CUDA_CHECK on all CUDA calls.

items.rationale: Correct for the configured parameters and arbitrary n; CPU-reference comparison included.
items.finding: Reduction handles arbitrary n (including non-multiples of block size) via OOB guard zeroing, combines partial sums on CPU, validates against CPU reference. Caveat: reduction loop assumes blockDim.x is a power of two; with threadsPerBlock=256 this holds.
items.evidence: blocksPerGrid = (n + threadsPerBlock - 1)/threadsPerBlock; OOB threads contribute 0.0f; CPU finalization sums h_partialSums; cpu/gpu comparison printed.
items.action: Optionally note the power-of-two block-size assumption or handle odd stride.

downstream_risks: Reduction loop assumes blockDim.x is power of two; threadsPerBlock=256 satisfies this, but n not multiple of blockDim could leave OOB reads handled correctly via guard. With non-power-of-two block sizes the reduction would be incorrect.
